propositions: Cloud Markdown descriptions and comments must encode as structured ADF through production codec paths instead of emitting plain-text paragraphs
DC Markdown descriptions and comments must render as native Jira wiki markup through production codec paths without content loss or monotonic length decay across repeated passes
Bidirectional sync must suppress echo loops via baseline recording and change-gated checksums while preserving Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) through origin gating
Concurrent local and remote edits must be detected and flagged as conflicts rather than silently overwriting either side
DC renderer must handle missing pandoc, timeouts, and pathological input with fallback to identity transformation without data loss
Unchanged reconciliation passes must add zero committed-state entries from rich-text processing and maintain idempotent round-trip conversion within acceptable performance bounds
